{{Top|leg}}
The '''Type IV-A Stardock''' was a model of [[Space station/Legends|space station]] designed by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].

==Characteristics==
The Type IV-A Stardock was 1,900 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] across, staffed by 200 officers, up to 50 workers and 24 [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]], and was armed with eight [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets. It could carry 5,000 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]].<ref name="Turning Point">{{JournalCite|5|Turning Point (Charlene Newcomb)}}</ref>

Ships up to and including an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] could be repaired by a station of this type.<ref name="Turning Point" />

==History==
The [[Wroona Stardock]] was a Type IV-A Spacedock that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].<ref name="Turning Point" />
